backfill_note: The original 2026-06-27 run (blog run #6) had its temporary fixture discarded per the finite-disk policy. fixture/.github/workflows/ was reconstructed from the recorded methodology. Unlike a live-database backfill (e.g. OSV), zizmor's offline scan is deterministic and version-pinned, so the reconstruction was RE-RUN on 2026-08-05 and reproduces the regular-persona result byte-for-byte: 15 findings, identical rule breakdown, identical severity split, SARIF rules 7 / results 15, exit 14. results.json therefore holds re-verified numbers, not just recorded ones. One honest gap: the pedantic/auditor persona counts drift slightly (24/24 today vs the 25/26 recorded on 2026-06-27) because the reconstructed fixture is faithful for the regular persona but not byte-identical to the deleted original; the monotonic escalation (regular < pedantic <= auditor) is the durable claim, exact higher-persona counts are fixture-detail-dependent.

environment.runner: uvx (uv 0.11.14), zizmor installed ephemerally into the uv cache
environment.note: Scan is fully offline (--offline): no network, no GitHub token, no Docker. Results are deterministic for a pinned zizmor version + fixed input, so they do not drift over time.

subject.name: zizmor
subject.install: uvx zizmor@1.26.1 (pinned, ephemeral; nothing installed globally)
subject.note: 1.26 shipped the typosquat-uses and unsound-ternary audits that this fixture exercises.

data_source.name: zizmor built-in audit corpus (offline)
data_source.drift_warning: None for the regular persona: pinned version + fixed fixture + --offline = deterministic. Higher personas surface additional low-confidence findings whose exact count depends on byte-level fixture details.

raw_artifacts.retention_policy: discarded at run time (finite local disk)
raw_artifacts.note: The original run's fixture and JSON/SARIF dumps were deleted after 2026-06-27. The reconstructed fixture is committed here and was re-executed on 2026-08-05; the summary numbers in results.json are that re-verified output. No fabricated hashes.
